issue.name: SQL Injection
issue.issueBackground: SQL injection vulnerabilities arise when user-controllable data is incorporated into database SQL queries in an unsafe manner.
issue.remediationBackground: Use parameterized queries (also known as prepared statements) for all SQL queries.
issue.vulnerabilityClassifications: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (reflected)
issue.issueBackground: Reflected cross-site scripting vulnerabilities arise when data is copied from a request and echoed into the application's immediate response in an unsafe way.

issue.name: Path traversal
issue.issueBackground: Path traversal vulnerabilities arise when user-controllable data is used to access files on the server filesystem.
issue.remediationBackground: Validate and sanitize user input before using it in file operations.

issue.name: TLS certificate (self-signed)
issue.issueBackground: The server is using a self-signed TLS certificate.
issue.remediationBackground: Install a certificate signed by a trusted certificate authority.

issue.name: CSRF token missing
issue.issueBackground: The application does not implement CSRF protection on this endpoint.
issue.remediationBackground: Implement CSRF tokens on all state-changing requests.
